item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 09/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The weather will be very hot with weak winds over the coast of Guangdong on the Mid-Autumn Festival and the day following. Showers triggered by high temperatures will also affect the region. A dry continental airstream will bring very hot and fine weather to southern China next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Muifa will linger over the seas east of Taiwan in the next few days and intensify gradually.

Weather: Mainly fine. Dry during the day. Cloudy periods and a few showers later.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
